tui_runtime_keys_footer_all_time: Footer hint after Esc while the custom time range prompt is open.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_apply: Footer hint after Enter while the custom time range prompt is open.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_attach: Short label of the TUI footer hint for i on a session tab, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_attached: Banner at the left of the footer while a session is attached; the code shows it in capitals with dashes around it.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_clear: Footer hint after Esc while typing a log search.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_detach: Short label of the TUI footer hint for D, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_detach_session: Footer hint after Ctrl+B in an attached session.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_find_filter: Footer hint after Tab while typing a log search: switches between highlighting matches and showing only them.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_follow: Short label of the TUI footer hint for f, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_following: Short label of the TUI footer hint for f while following new lines; shown green, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_help: Short label of the TUI footer hint for ?, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_keep: Footer hint after Enter while typing a log search.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_kill_session: Footer hint after Ctrl+C in an attached session.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_level: Short label of the TUI footer hint for v, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_menu: Short label of the TUI footer hint for m, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_next_tab: Short label of the TUI footer hint for Tab, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_palette: Short label of the TUI footer hint for :, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_paused: Short label of the TUI footer hint for f while paused; shown yellow, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_quit: Short label of the TUI footer hint for q, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_regex: Footer hint after Ctrl+R while typing a log search.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_restart: Short label of the TUI footer hint for r on a service tab, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_restart_all: Short label of the TUI footer hint for r on the All tab, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_scroll: Short label of the TUI footer hint for j/k, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_search_active: Short label of the TUI footer hint for / while a search is active; n/N are the keys, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_start: Short label of the TUI footer hint for r on a stopped service, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_stop: Short label of the TUI footer hint for s, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_time: Short label of the TUI footer hint for V, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_zoom: Short label of the TUI footer hint for z, after the key.
tui_runtime_keys_footer_zoom_on: Short label of the TUI footer hint for z while zoomed; shown yellow, after the key.
